title: Two Broad Separated 2D Gaussians (Published Prior Cohort)
intuition: Published-prior cohort variant of `vector_two_broad` with explicit `learnable=True` MoG prior declaration, testing transfer consistency across minor prior-contract differences. Baseline 2D multimodal vector task with two broad isotropic Gaussians at (-1, 0) and (+1, 0) (sigma=0.25), checking basic multimodal coverage, balanced mass, and accurate within-mode spread.
failure_mode: Recipes that collapse mode variance to points fail component_min_eigen_ratio and component_covariance_error.
protocol_notes: Separate published transfer cohort of `vector_two_broad`; historical sensitivity observed across architectures.
